seo.description: Seene reminds your clients about their bookings on WhatsApp, tells you who is due for a fill, and counts what you earned. For nail, brow and lash artists. Free, no commission.

recall.title: New clients are nice. Returning ones cost less and are more reliable.
recall.description: Seene knows how often each client comes and lists those who are due for a fill. All that’s left is to pick a slot and tap “Invite”.

recall.p2: Ready texts: fill, birthday, free slot

commission.title: 0% commission.
commission.text: Marketplaces take a cut of every new client. Seene takes nothing: your clients, your money. The basics are free, and Pro costs less than one manicure a month.

founders.title: Be one of the first 20.
founders.text: We’re launching in Bishkek, Toronto and Vancouver together with beauty pros. In return for honest feedback, you get what nobody else will.

install.q: Do my clients need to install anything?
install.a: No. Reminders arrive in their regular WhatsApp, and booking opens from a link in the browser.

robot.q: Are the messages written by a bot?
robot.a: No. Seene drafts the text, and you send it from your own number. You can change any word.

price.a: Calendar, clients and reminders are free. Pro with “time to invite” and money tracking costs less than one manicure a month.

data.a: Only you. We don’t sell data and we don’t message your clients. You can delete your whole account in settings.
